title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Matthew 6: giving, praying and fasting in secret, treasures in heaven, and not being anxious.

questions.text: What do the hypocrites do when they do merciful deeds?
questions.explanation: They sound a trumpet before themselves in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they may get glory from men.

answers.text: They pray in their inner room
They sound a trumpet before themselves
They anoint their head and wash their face
They give in secret to their neighbors

questions.text: What should your left hand not know when you do merciful deeds?
questions.explanation: When you do merciful deeds, your left hand should not know what your right hand does, so the deed stays secret.

questions.text: Where does Jesus tell them to go to pray?
questions.explanation: He tells them to enter into their inner room, shut the door, and pray to their Father who is in secret.

answers.text: Into your inner room with the door shut
Into the corners of the streets
Into the synagogue with the hypocrites
Onto the housetop in the evening

questions.text: What does the prayer ask God to give today?
questions.explanation: The prayer says: Give us today our daily bread.

questions.text: What does the prayer ask God to forgive?
questions.explanation: The prayer asks: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

questions.text: What does Jesus tell them to do when they fast?
questions.explanation: He tells them to anoint their head and wash their face, so that they are not seen by men to be fasting.

answers.text: Anoint your head and wash your face
Sound a trumpet in the street

questions.text: Where should they lay up treasures, where no moth or rust consumes?
questions.explanation: They are told not to lay up treasures on the earth, but to lay up treasures in heaven, where moth and rust do not consume.

questions.text: Which two does Jesus say no one can serve together?
questions.explanation: No one can serve two masters: you can't serve both God and Mammon.

questions.text: Which creatures does Jesus point to that do not sow or reap, yet are fed by the Father?
questions.explanation: He points to the birds of the sky, which do not sow, reap or gather into barns, and their heavenly Father feeds them.

questions.text: What does Jesus tell them to seek first?
questions.explanation: He tells them to seek first God's Kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to them as well.

answers.text: The reward of men in the streets
The glory that the Gentiles seek
